---
title: "Measure-Theoretic Probability — Rosenthal"
---

**Primary text.** Jeffrey Rosenthal, *A First Look at Rigorous Probability Theory*.

**Phase window.** 2027-02-01 → 2027-07-25. ~25 weeks (~6 months).

**Why.** The original target of this whole effort. Direct payoff for Bayesian modeling (posteriors as conditional expectations, Radon-Nikodym as likelihoods), sequential trial design (martingales, optional stopping), and limit theorems used routinely without their measure-theoretic justification.

## After Phase 3

Two natural continuations, choose at the time:

- **Martingales →** Williams, *Probability with Martingales*. Optional stopping, sequential trials.
- **Radon-Nikodym →** densities, likelihoods, change of measure. Direct line back to Bayesian inference.
